description: List Salesforce records of one object (Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Task, Event, Case), newest change first. Filters: owner_id, account_id (Contact/Opportunity/Case/Task/Event), open_only (Lead not converted, Opportunity/Task/Case not closed, Event not past), modified_since, and an optional SOQL `where` (read-only, ANDed). Default fields are standard fields; pass `fields` for more (see describe_salesforce_object). Read-only.

open_only.description: true = only open records (Lead not converted, Opportunity/Task/Case not closed, Event not past)

name: list_salesforce_records
